item.title: [ransomware] Cybercriminals take aim at Hasbro, weeks of recovery ahead
item.description: <p>Hasbro, an American toy maker with more than 5,000 employees, confirmed a cyberattack and proactively took certain systems offline. The intrusion was detected on March 28, and the company promptly activated its incident response protocols.
